campaign.title: M1 lower scalar exact denominator-displacement quadratic gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: The round is an exact internal scalar gate. A named Weyl, Gauss, Salie, Poisson, or spectral estimate is admissible only after its variable ranges, coefficient class, completion cost, absolute-value placement, q-uniformity, and complete R-power ledger are stated and checked.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact prescribed-centre lower scalar be bounded at R X^epsilon after the centre-constrained substitution N=y^2+q and d=y-v by a genuinely noninvertible quadratic Gauss or Salie cancellation in the physical displacement variable; if not, what is the first exact Taylor, completion, alias, boundary, self-return, or capacity obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let R=X^(1/4), y=floor(sqrt X), N=floor X, q=N-y^2 with 0<=q<=2y. The exact scalar is F_N=sum_(h>=1)h^(-1)sum_(0<=v<y)chi_4(y-v)V_low(4R^2h^2/(y-v)^2)e(h(q+v^2)/(y-v)), with literal zero extension and target |F_N|<<_epsilon R X^epsilon.
quantities: The identity N/(y-v)=y+v+(q+v^2)/(y-v) is exact; the discarded term h(y+v) is integral.
For y-v odd, the complete physical phase is h(q+v^2)/(y-v)+(y-v-1)/4; even y-v terms vanish.
The exact quadratic-core expansion has correction h v(q+v^2)/(y(y-v)); it may not be dropped or bounded outside its proved range.
The literal profile restricts h relative to y-v and must remain smooth with every endpoint and zero-extension owner.
Round 138 already deletes complete denominator rows and both y^(-2) carrier collars; the present mechanism must either estimate the full scalar or map its gain back to that exact residual.
The scalar has y^(1+o(1)) absolute capacity and target R; any partial modulus, completion, or dyadic sum must return to R.
Fourth-power q=0, maximal q=2y, small v, v near y, half-integer stationary aliases, both parities of y, and both scalar signs are mandatory controls.

completion_criteria: Derive the displacement identity in both directions, including q, parity, literal profile support, zero extension, floors, and both signs.
Separate a rational quadratic core only with an exact formula for its correction and a complete range-by-range R-power ledger.
For every Gauss, Salie, Weyl, Poisson, completion, or differencing step, retain the actual h-weight, character carrier, q-dependence, and boundary terms.
Test q=0, q=2y, small and terminal displacement, stationary half-integer aliases, fourth powers, and any claimed complete-sum cancellation.

Preserve scalar directionality: no displacement-block modulus, arbitrary coefficient theorem, centre average, principal-only transform, or desired circle estimate may substitute for the literal scalar.
Close under exactly one label: target_bound, strict_displacement_quadratic_reduction, or displacement_quadratic_no_go.
Make no lower-GAR, blockwise M1, M9-M1, M2, endpoint, M9, quarter, or exponent promotion unless every corresponding owner closes.

closing_assessment.main_result: The complete exact-phase collar v<=rho y/sqrt(h) is O(R log X), so the literal lower scalar is target-equivalent to its complementary displacement tail. The prescribed-centre Taylor window is also target-safe, but full quadratic completion is obstructed by correction variation, ordinary-Gauss Fourier self-return, and R^(3/2) full-alias capacity. The tail and Round-138 residual bounds remain open.

review_seams.requirement: The N=y^2+q and d=y-v identity is exact in both directions, with q range, parity, profile, floors, zero extension, and signs retained.
Every rational quadratic core is accompanied by its exact correction and a proved range in which completion or approximation is legal.
Gauss, Salie, Weyl, Poisson, or differencing steps state the exact modulus, length, coefficients, gcd cases, boundary terms, and completion cost.
Every dyadic or stationary estimate returns to the R scalar target uniformly in h, v, q, y, and real X.
No partial modulus, arbitrary array, centre average, principal-only identity, or invertible self-return substitutes for the literal signed scalar.
Only the displacement scalar or its exact Round-138 residual may change; every lower-GAR and downstream owner requires separate closure.
